release_notes:
Fix: Zelle duplicate-settlement guard blocks legitimate repeat payments

The reconcile cron's anti-double-credit guard (gf_payment_user_recently_settled)
blocks crediting an invoice if the same user already has another settled invoice
at the identical amount/currency/method within the match window. That's too
blunt: a customer who genuinely sends two separate $10 Zelle payments minutes
apart gets the second one permanently stuck, since every subsequent cron run
re-evaluates the same still-true condition forever.

Every automated credit stamps TransactionId with its source email's unique
Message-ID, so we can tell "same deposit misattributed twice" apart from "two
distinct deposits" directly: added gf_zelle_distinct_settlement(), which only
lets a blocked credit through when the invoice that triggered the guard was
itself settled using a different, already-recorded reference than the one
currently in hand. Applied at all three places zelle_reconcile.php consults
the guard. gf_payment_user_recently_settled() itself is unchanged.
